description: A round face has short vertical eyes beneath sharply inward-sloping eyebrows. A deep downturned mouth fills the lower half, and the paired features give the expression a nearly symmetrical scowl.
A round head is flanked by two rounded tufts of clown hair that curl outward at the upper sides and narrow against the cheeks. The interior of the face is blank.
A circular face has two short upright eyes beneath raised inner eyebrows. A small downturned mouth sits below, with the paired brows and eyes arranged evenly across the face.
A round face has small upright eyes and a downturned mouth. The eyebrows are uneven, with a small upright notch on the left brow and a short sloping right brow.
A rounded blank head wears a cowboy hat with a broad horizontal brim curling upward at both ends. The crown has sloping sides and a shallow dip in its top.
A circular face has two small upright eyes and a straight horizontal mouth. A long rounded tongue hangs centrally from the mouth and reaches close to the bottom of the face.
A circular face has an X-shaped left eye and a round open right eye. Its broad tilted grin contains a long central tongue with a crease running down it.
A round face with closed curved eyes and a tall oval mouth releases two long streams of tears. Each stream widens into a pool below, interrupting the lower face outline.
A circular face has worried arched eyebrows above closed, drooping eyes. A pronounced downturned mouth occupies the lower face, with the brows and eyelids following a balanced paired arrangement.
A round face has small upright eyes under high, drooping eyebrows. The open mouth is broad and downturned, with a curved lower edge that gives it a distressed wailing shape.
A round face has short upright eyes beneath eyebrows slanting sharply toward the centre. A broad downturned mouth curves across the lower half, forming an evenly paired angry expression.
A circular face has two upright eyes beneath gently sloping eyebrows whose inner ends rise. A broad downturned mouth sits below, with all the facial features arranged in balanced pairs.
A circular face has short vertical eyes beneath straight horizontal eyebrows. A shallow downturned mouth spans the lower middle of the face, giving the evenly arranged features a flat expression.
A round face wears two circular spectacle lenses joined by a short bridge. Beneath the glasses is a curled nose-like arch above a broad rounded moustache shape; the surrounding face is blank.
A round face has two closed arching eyes and a broad open downturned mouth. A narrow rounded strand of drool hangs from the right side of the lower lip.
A round face has two closed arching eyes above a broad curved smile. A narrow loop of drool hangs from the right side of the mouth, making the expression asymmetrical.
A surprised round head has small upright eyes and an oval open mouth. Its jagged open top connects to a rising burst that spreads into a broad scalloped explosion cloud.
A round, otherwise blank head has a large circular monocle at its upper right. A long narrow loop descends from the monocle beside the cheek, where the head outline is interrupted.
A circular face has closed curved eyes and a downturned mouth. A long wavy brow line stretches across the forehead, rising on the left and dipping before its right end.
A round face has two short horizontal eyes beneath mostly level eyebrows. A deep downturned mouth fills the lower half, with the eyes and eyebrows giving it a heavy, tired look.
A head above curved shoulders has X-shaped eyes and a small frown. Three wavy heat trails rise from its open crown, with the outside trails continuing into the head outline.
A circular face has two large inward-curling spiral eyes. A straight horizontal mouth sits beneath them, and the paired spirals occupy most of the upper half of the face.
A round face has two matching heart-shaped eyes above a wide curved smile. The hearts stand in place of the eyes and are evenly positioned within the circular outline.
A round face has short upright eyes and a downturned mouth. A large pointed sweat drop sits at its upper-right temple, beside a gap in the circular head outline.
A round face has two closed arching eyes and pursed lips. The lips form a small vertical double curve at the centre, beneath the otherwise evenly spaced eyes.
A hand extends an upright thumb above a closed fist, with the curled fingers forming a scalloped right edge. A rectangular cuff attaches to the wrist on the left.
A rounded head faces left, with a projecting nose and one closed arched eye. Its wide open laughing mouth cuts into the lower-left outline and contains a curved tongue.
A circular laughing face is turned sideways, placing its two closed eyes along the left side. A tall open grin fills the right side, with a curved tongue inside.
A round face has closed arched eyes and a broad open smile. Two large teardrops sit at the outer cheeks, where gaps interrupt the head outline on either side.
A circular face is divided vertically down its centre, with a closed eye on each side. Its mouth smiles on the left and frowns on the right beside a teardrop.
A round face with closed eyes holds a broad triangular tissue over the nose and mouth. The tissue extends below the chin, with an upright fold dividing its lower portion.
A round face with closed eyes presses a draped tissue against its nose. The tissue hangs below the face with an uneven lower edge, a long central fold, and a shorter side flap.
A round face has one tightly closed eye beneath a raised curved brow and an X-shaped eye on the right. Its broad open mouth bends downward in a distressed grimace.
A round face has a closed left eye beneath an arched brow and an X-shaped right eye. A broad open downturned mouth occupies the lower face, making an asymmetrical pained expression.
A round face wears a pointed party hat leaning toward the upper left. Closed smiling eyes sit above pursed lips holding a party blower that extends right and curls upward.
A circular face has two long straight vertical eyes and a large oval open mouth. The sparse features are evenly arranged, with the mouth occupying the lower centre of the face.
A coiled mound of poo rises from a broad flattened base through rounded tiers to a curved point. Two oval eyes and a wide open smile sit on the front.
A circular face has inward-slanting eyebrows above curled eyes. A broad smile curves upward at both ends, with a short rounded tongue hanging from its centre beneath the mischievous expression.
A round face has inward-sloping eyebrows and tightly closed eyes. Two diagonal jets extend from its nose toward the lower corners, ending in scalloped steam clouds across the cheeks.
A round face has raised inner eyebrows and squeezed curved eyes above an open downturned mouth. A single pointed tear sits on the right cheek beside the mouth.
A round face has raised inner eyebrows above closed, drooping eyes. A deep downturned mouth fills the lower half, with the paired brow and eyelid curves conveying a crestfallen expression.
A circular face wears broad spectacles joined across the nose, with their arms reaching the head outline. Drooping eyes and raised inner eyebrows accompany a downturned mouth beneath the lenses.
A round face has small upright eyes beneath eyebrows that curve upward toward the centre. A short downturned mouth sits below, with a small irregular hook visible on the right eye.
A circular face has small upright eyes beneath high, worried eyebrows. A broad downturned mouth fills the lower face, with a large gap between the eyes and raised brows.
A circular face has two large round open eyes and a tall oval mouth. The eyes sit evenly apart above the mouth, with no eyebrows or other interior facial marks.
A circular face has two round open eyes above an oval open mouth. The eyes are evenly placed and smaller than the mouth, leaving the remainder of the face blank.
A round face has tightly squeezed eyes shaped like inward-facing angles. A wavy mouth runs beneath them, dipping centrally between two raised curves to create a tense grimace.
A round face has closed arching eyes and a small mouth partly hidden by an upright index finger. The finger rises from a curled hand that overlaps the lower face.
A round face wears a rectangular medical mask over its nose and mouth, held by diagonal straps extending to both cheeks. Two short, slightly uneven eye marks remain visible above it.
A round face has two short upright eyes above a broad upward-curving smile. The simple paired eyes and centred mouth sit within an uninterrupted circular outline without other facial details.
A rounded demon head has two pointed horns sweeping upward from its upper sides. Two short inward-sloping curved marks sit high inside the otherwise blank face, which has no visible mouth.
A round face wears broad glasses with flat upper rims, a central bridge, and rounded lower lenses. Closed curved eyes sit behind them, above an asymmetrical smile rising on the right.
A round face has raised inner eyebrows over large curled eye shapes. A small downturned mouth sits low between them, with the brows and eyes arranged in a roughly symmetrical pleading expression.
A round face has raised inner eyebrows, tightly squeezed eyes, and a wide open mouth. Vomit flows downward from the mouth into a broad uneven pool with two short interior marks.
A round face has two closed arching eyes above a broad smile. A long rounded tongue hangs centrally from the mouth, with a short crease extending down its middle.
A circular face has closed arching eyes and a broad upward-curving smile. A wide rounded tongue extends below the mouth, with a central crease dividing its upper portion.
A circular face has two X-shaped eyes above a broad curved smile. A long rounded tongue hangs from the mouth, with a crease running down its centre.
A round face has closed arching eyes and a wide curved smile. A narrow rounded tongue hangs from the right half of the mouth, leaving the expression visibly asymmetrical.
A circular face has raised curved eyebrows and closed drooping eyes. Its small open mouth is uneven, with a rounded upper edge and a notched lower curve shifted toward the right.
A round face has two closed downward-curving eyes above a large oval open mouth. The evenly spaced eyes and centred mouth are the only features within the circular outline.
A round face has two closed curved eyes and a large open mouth. The mouth narrows toward a short flat lower edge, while the outer head remains smoothly rounded.
A circular face has two tiny horizontal eyes above a zipped mouth. A horizontal zipper with four upright teeth ends in a rounded pull tab at the right cheek.
